verdict.rationale: Base44 markets AI-driven previews before changes are applied (docs-14) and lets users send follow-up instructions to the AI from a shared board (docs-12), suggesting some iterative safety, and community feedback broadly praises the AI's ability to build/extend apps (base44-comm-4, base44-comm-5). However there is no explicit documentation or hands-on evidence about preserving prior functionality, versioning, rollback, or regression protection when iterating via prompts, and comm-8 notes users can hit walls that cost money without resolving issues cleanly. Missing for 10: explicit non-regression/version-history mechanism, documented safeguards against breaking existing features, and independent confirmation that follow-up prompts don't degrade prior work.
